templates.title: Motion showreel
templates.blurb: Show off: 4–6 techniques and a title card.
templates.prompt: A dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. Go all out.
templates.structure: a fast sequence of 4–6 visually distinct ideas, each using a different technique, tied together with transitions and ending on a title card

templates.title: Product launch
templates.blurb: Hook, product reveal, three features, call to action.
templates.prompt: Launch video for Lumen, an app that turns meeting notes into tasks. Headline: "Meetings that do the work." Features: auto-assigned tasks, Slack sync, weekly digest. End with lumen.app
templates.structure: hook in the first 10%, product name reveal, one beat per feature with a simple UI-like illustration, end card with the call to action held for the last 15%

templates.title: App walkthrough
templates.blurb: A cursor clicks through your product's UI.
templates.prompt: A walkthrough of Northwind, a CRM for small agencies: open the dashboard, click a client, drag a deal to "Won", watch revenue update. End with "Northwind — your pipeline, finally calm."
templates.structure: recreate a clean, believable app UI with canvas shapes (sidebar, header, cards, lists, charts); an animated cursor performs 3–4 actions with clicks and state changes; zoom in on the key moment; end with the product name and tagline

templates.title: Social ad 9:16
templates.blurb: Vertical, punchy, hook in the first second.
templates.prompt: A punchy vertical ad for Brewly cold brew: hook in the first second, then "50% less sugar, 100% the kick", end with "Try it at brewly.co"
templates.structure: a hook in the first second, 3–4 quick beats with big centred type, a final call-to-action card; designed for a phone screen

templates.title: Logo reveal
templates.blurb: An abstract build-up that resolves into your wordmark.
templates.prompt: A premium logo reveal for NORTHWIND with the tagline "Built for the long haul."
templates.structure: abstract shapes and light build tension, converge into the wordmark, then the tagline; hold the final lockup for the last 25%

templates.title: Explainer
templates.blurb: A concept in clear, animated steps.
templates.prompt: Explain how compound interest works in three steps: you invest, your returns earn returns, growth speeds up over time.
templates.structure: title card, then one numbered step per scene with a simple diagram that builds up, then a one-line summary

templates.title: Data story
templates.prompt: Animate our year in numbers: 12,480 new users, revenue up 214%, 99.98% uptime. Theme: celebratory but credible.
templates.structure: one metric per beat using count-ups and self-drawing charts, then a closing takeaway line

templates.title: 3D world
templates.blurb: A cinematic camera move through a place or era.
templates.prompt: A cinematic flight over a 1920s harbour town at golden hour: fog on the water, warm window lights coming on, ending on the title "Harbourlight".
templates.structure: a Three.js (or carefully projected canvas) 3D scene with atmospheric lighting and fog; 2–3 continuous camera moves (dolly, crane, orbit) instead of cuts; a restrained title overlay at the end

templates.title: Game moment
templates.blurb: Card reveals, level-ups and trailer beats.
templates.prompt: A gacha reveal for my mobile game Star Summon: a glowing pack bursts open, an SSR card for the hero Noctis flips over, stats count up, then the logo.
templates.structure: anticipation (charging glow, shaking), an explosive reveal with light rays and particles, the reward shown clearly with its stats or rarity, then the game logo

templates.title: Kinetic quote
templates.blurb: A quote or lyric animated word by word.
templates.prompt: Animate this quote word by word: "Make it work, make it right, make it fast." — Kent Beck
templates.structure: words or short phrases appear in rhythm, with emphasis words given bigger type and a distinct motion, the attribution last

templates.title: Recipe & how-to
templates.blurb: Ingredients, steps and timers, like a recipe card.
templates.prompt: A recipe card for 10-minute garlic noodles: ingredients appear one by one, then 4 steps with timers, ending with the finished bowl.
templates.structure: title, an ingredient list that builds up, numbered steps with simple illustrations and timers, a finished-result card

prompts.title: Résumé reel that promotes a brand
prompts.note: Spells out the structure: a hook in the first second, a run of distinct techniques, a clean final frame.
prompts.prompt:
You're a world-class motion designer, and this is your 15-second résumé reel. Make it dynamic and confident: open with a striking hook in the first second, build through a sequence of distinct techniques (typography, shape play, camera moves, colour shifts), and land on a clean, memorable final frame. Pacing should feel like it's cut to music. Go crazy.

Make it promote our brand, reflex. inc. Proceed as if you were starting with zero of my tools. Do not assume that the tools we already have are the best to use, as they might be outdated.
